definitions.explanation: The basic substance from which something is made.
Material used as the basis for creative work or study.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{素材|そざい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{軽|かる}い→軽い：00785_karui⟧。
⟦{天然|てんねん}→天然：03560_tennen⟧{素材|そざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
⟦{小説|しょうせつ}→小説：01434_shousetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{素材|そざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{集|あつ}める→集める：01170_atsumeru⟧。
examples.english: To gather material for a novel.

notes:
{素材|そざい} refers to the basic substance or raw material from which something is made, or the source material for creative work.

SENSE 1 - PHYSICAL MATERIAL:
- ⟦{天然|てんねん}→天然：03560_tennen⟧{素材|そざい} (natural material)
- ⟦{合成|ごうせい}→合成：12027_gousei⟧{素材|そざい} (synthetic material)
- {素材|そざい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧ (good quality material)
- {素材|そざい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{味|あじ}→味：00826_aji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{生|い}かす (bring out the natural flavor of ingredients)

SENSE 2 - SOURCE MATERIAL:
- ⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{素材|そざい} (material for a film)
- ⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{素材|そざい} (subject matter for a work)
- {素材|そざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{集|あつ}める→集める：01170_atsumeru⟧ (gather material)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{材料|ざいりょう}→材料：02831_zairyou⟧: more concrete, refers to specific materials or ingredients used to make something
- ⟦{原料|げんりょう}→原料：11802_genryou⟧: raw materials that undergo chemical transformation (e.g., oil for plastics)
- {素材|そざい}: emphasizes the inherent quality or potential of the material
